instruction: Please change all slide backgrounds to cyan in my presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing background color to cyan (RGB: 0, 255, 255) on all 19 slides. Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance function to verify RGB distance from target color. Original background is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies ALL slide backgrounds changed to cyan (RGB: 0, 255, 255)
Metric 'evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance' iterates through all slides and computes RGB distance for each
Handles both direct background fills (type 1) and master slide inherited fills (type 5)
Expected RGB values are semantically correct: cyan=[0,255,255], original white=[255,255,255]
Postconfig properly saves file with Ctrl+S before verification, ensuring fresh state
Getter 'get_vm_file' correctly fetches the modified PPTX file from VM
Scoring logic is sound: returns similarity score where 1.0 means perfect match across all slides
Complete coverage: instruction requires 'all slides' and evaluator checks all slides
